intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} are both private institutes in {{cityA}}. This page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.

IMS Noida vs Jaipuria Noida is not a single winner. Jaipuria Noida holds a NIRF 2025 Management rank of 41. IMS Noida's official PGDM fee is lower, but our table still shows only a ₹2 lakh MBA year tuition.

sections.heading: IMS Noida vs Jaipuria Noida for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Jaipuria Noida if you want an AICTE-approved PGDM, a NIRF 2025 Management rank, and a shortlist that can use CAT, XAT or ATMA.
Choose IMS Noida if a lower official two-year PGDM fee in the same Sector 62 cluster matters more than that NIRF rank, and you will recheck the current fee notice before you pay.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: Our comparison table currently adds two Jaipuria year figures of ₹7.30 lakh and ₹7.20 lakh, and shows ₹14.50 lakh for PGDM (Marketing). That sum is not the official 2026–28 programme total.

On Jaipuria's Noida fee page, PGDM, PGDM (Marketing) and PGDM (Service Management) for 2026–28 cost ₹8.30 lakh in year one and ₹8.20 lakh in year two, or ₹16.50 lakh in all, plus a ₹15,000 refundable deposit.
For IMS Noida our records list only ₹2 lakh as MBA tuition for one year, with no programme-total row. The institute's official PGDM site states a two-year fee of ₹8.51 lakh (₹4.51 lakh then ₹4 lakh).
Use those official totals when you compare cost. Hostel and mess are extra on the Jaipuria page, and our IMS row is still a year tuition, not a confirmed two-year total.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Our table records a 2023 Jaipuria Noida PGDM Finance figure of ₹11 lakh average and ₹22 lakh highest, and a 2023 IMS Noida PGDM figure of ₹9 lakh average and ₹27 lakh highest. These are historical records, not promises.

Jaipuria's placements page reports an all-campus 2024–26 highest package of ₹24.11 LPA, with the season still underway across Noida, Lucknow, Jaipur and Indore. That page does not isolate a Noida-only average.
Until a campus-only 2025 report is in our table, read the 2023 Noida figures and the all-campus 2024–26 note side by side, and ask the placement cell for the latest PDF.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Jaipuria Noida is listed with CAT, XAT and ATMA, typically followed by an interview. IMS Noida is listed with CAT on this page; confirm any other tests the current PGDM brochure still accepts.
Both programmes are two-year postgraduate management courses. Check the official admissions page for the exact graduation marks, work-experience rules and fee-payment deadlines for the 2026–28 batch.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses sit in Noida's Sector 62 institutional area, close to Delhi NCR offices and metro links, so daily travel is similar.
Jaipuria Noida is a dedicated PGDM campus. IMS Noida also runs a wider mix of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes on the same site, which changes the student group you will study with.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Jaipuria Noida if the NIRF 2025 Management rank of 41, the official ₹16.50 lakh 2026–28 PGDM fee, and the CAT, XAT or ATMA route match your plan.
Pick IMS Noida if you want the official ₹8.51 lakh two-year PGDM fee in the same neighbourhood and you have checked the current brochure yourself.
If you need a 2025 Noida-only average package, ask both placement cells for the latest report. Our 2023 figures should not be stretched beyond that year.

faqs.question: Which is better for MBA / PGDM, IMS Noida or Jaipuria Noida?
faqs.answer: There is no universal winner. Jaipuria Noida has a NIRF 2025 Management rank of 41 and a higher official 2026–28 PGDM fee. IMS Noida's official PGDM fee is lower. Choose by rank need, budget and the current placement report.

faqs.question: What is the official PGDM fee at Jaipuria Noida for 2026–28?
faqs.answer: Jaipuria's Noida fee page lists ₹16.50 lakh for PGDM, PGDM (Marketing) and PGDM (Service Management) in 2026–28, billed as ₹8.30 lakh plus ₹8.20 lakh, with a ₹15,000 refundable deposit extra. Hostel is separate.

faqs.question: What fee should I use for IMS Noida?
faqs.answer: Our table still shows ₹2 lakh as one year's MBA tuition, which is not a two-year total. The official PGDM site states ₹8.51 lakh for two years. Use that official figure until our table carries a confirmed total.

faqs.question: What placement figures are on record for the two campuses?
faqs.answer: We hold 2023 records: Jaipuria Noida PGDM Finance at ₹11 lakh average and ₹22 lakh highest, and IMS Noida PGDM at ₹9 lakh average and ₹27 lakh highest. Jaipuria's site also quotes an all-campus 2024–26 highest of ₹24.11 LPA.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do IMS Noida and Jaipuria Noida accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CAT, XAT and ATMA for Jaipuria Noida, and CAT for IMS Noida. Always confirm the current exam list and cut-offs on the official admissions pages before you apply.

faqs.question: Are the two campuses far from each other?
faqs.answer: No. Both are in Sector 62, Noida, in the same institutional cluster. The commute to Delhi NCR offices is similar; the difference is the programme mix and the official fee and ranking profile.
